contract.evidence: the summary does not state a checked/unchecked contract for this arm

treatment.design: same region lowering as typed-scalar, but the producer is one 16-byte load, one eight-lane signed saturating subtraction and one 16-byte scratch store; it targets the discriminant subtraction of the inner pixel loop
treatment.notA: an intervention targeted at stack traffic; the hit continuation (lookup, depth compare, stores) stays ordinary scalar code

provenance.note: curated from the attached study and capture sources; not read from the profile entry and not covered by source.digest

countsCover.workload: one runRv32 call of typedRayComputeRow per fixture row; each must not trap, must return 1 and must reproduce fixtures/<y>.gold
countsCover.counter: runRv32 per-PC hook over the whole call; the script applies no symbol-range filter

totals.instructions.meaning: RV32 interpreter steps (r.steps): one decoded instruction per step, a packed instruction counts once

totals.packets.isNot: a separately counted number of packed groups

totals.stackLoads.meaning: executed PCs whose 32-bit word has rs1 = sp and major opcode LOAD (any integer width), summed over the workload
totals.stackLoads.isNot: a stack-slot or spill count; compressed and vendor encodings are not decoded

totals.stackStores.meaning: executed PCs whose 32-bit word has rs1 = sp and major opcode STORE (any integer width), summed over the workload
totals.stackStores.isNot: a stack-slot or spill count; compressed and vendor encodings are not decoded

rowBytes.meaning: absent from this summary: typed-counts.mjs records no code size
rowBytes.isNot: a Typed image size; image bytes are a study figure (study.md)

samples.meaning: per-row totals for a few fixture rows, keyed by row index

rowsVerified.meaning: row inputs whose output equalled fixtures/<y>.gold

comparisons.isolates: the packet producer only (scalar lane fill vs packed subtraction)
comparisons.heldEqual: source, workload, counters, admission, memory intervals, iteration domain, lane consumer, fallback

comparisons.isolates: no single change: region lowering plus packed producer

cannotAttribute: an individual stack slot, frame offset or PC: totals and row samples carry no addresses (see q.joinPCs)
spill vs prologue/epilogue save vs local stack home vs scratch: the predicate sees only the base register sp
an individual optimization inside a treatment that bundles several changes
cycles or ESP32-P4 board time: these are emulator counts
trap-path behaviour: every workload input is a valid row
describe.timing: emulator counts only; ESP32-P4 timings are a separate study layer, not loaded as a profile

cells.source: const segs = ['admission and packet control','halfword producer and sign guard','scalar hit continuation','packet backedge']; const segCheck = ['scalar','pie','empty','full'].map(arm => { const d = simd.decisions().find(d => d.id === arm + '-row'); const rs = d.ranges.filter(r => segs.includes(r.role)).sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start); let overlaps = 0; for (let i = 1; i < rs.length; i++) if (rs[i].start < rs[i - 1].end) overlaps++; const fn = d.ranges.find(r => r.role === 'function'); const c = simd.counts(arm + '-opening'); const inSeg = pc => rs.some(r => pc >= r.start && pc < r.end); const segX = c.counts.filter(x => inSeg(x.pc)).reduce((n, x) => n + x.executions, 0); const outsideFn = c.counts.filter(x => x.pc < fn.start || x.pc >= fn.end).length; return {arm, segRanges: rs.length, overlaps, fn: [fn.start, fn.end], inSegments: segX, outsideSegments: c.steps - segX, pcsOutsideFunction: outsideFn, steps: c.steps} }); const ps = simd.packets('opening-160-rows'); const mix = {}; for (const p of ps.packets) { const k = p.hitMask === 0 ? 'allMiss' : p.hitMask === 255 ? 'allHit' : 'mixed'; mix[k] = (mix[k] || 0) + 1 } const lanes = [...new Set(ps.packets.map(p => p.lanes))]; const rows = new Set(ps.packets.map(p => p.row)).size; const hitLanes = ps.packets.reduce((n, p) => { let m = p.hitMask, k = 0; while (m) { k += m & 1; m >>= 1 } return n + k }, 0); let noPhysicsPackets; try { simd.packets('particle-n128') } catch (e) { noPhysicsPackets = String(e) } ({segCheck, packets: {workload: ps.workload, sourceSHA: ps.sourceSHA, n: ps.packets.length, lanes, rowsWithPackets: rows, mix, hitLanes, poses: [...new Set(ps.packets.map(p => p.pose))]}, sourceSHAsOfRayDecisions: [...new Set(simd.decisions().filter(d => d.function === 'typedRayComputeRow').map(d => d.source.sha256))], noPhysicsPackets})
